• About our brand and products: BURKER is a Dutch minimalist feminine watch brand selling globally at www.burkerwatches.com

• What makes us different: Clean minimalistic classic design, strong brand identity, and a loyal and growing community of watch lovers. Our products are made only for women, they are highly visual and perform exceptionally well on social media.

• How affiliates can earn: Welcome gift on start + 10% commission on every sale via your personal link or code. Bonuses unlock at sales milestones. Payouts via Wise, minimum €100.

• How to promote us: Instagram and TikTok: Reels, Stories, organic mentions. We provide support. We'd love you can create high quality content

• Other information: We look for consistent, long-term partners.
payout_period: Payouts via Wise, we sent the payment once minimum threshold €100 reached (once per month)

Terms and Conditions

1. Introduction

These Terms and Conditions govern participation in the BURKER Affiliate Programme, operated by Burker International BV (Rijder 1-b1, 1507 DP Zaandam, Netherlands, CoC: 67266304). By joining the programme, you agree to comply with all terms outlined below. BURKER reserves the right to update these terms at any time with reasonable notice.


2. Eligibility

  • Applicants must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Applicants must have an active and authentic social media presence on Instagram and/or TikTok.
  • Affiliates must only promote BURKER through social media accounts that are their own and under their full control. Using or referencing accounts belonging to third parties is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate account termination.
  • BURKER reserves the right to approve or decline any application at its sole discretion.
  • Accounts with no activity for 60 or more consecutive days may be automatically deactivated.


3. Permitted Promotional Channels

Affiliates may only promote BURKER through the following approved channels:

  • Personal social media content on Instagram and TikTok (Stories, Reels, videos, carousels)
  • Blogs and editorial content
  • Communities and forums (with authentic, non-spam engagement)
  • SEO and organic content
  • Email marketing to personal, opted-in audiences
  • Social messenger apps
  • Display banners and social media ads (must not use BURKER brand name in ad targeting, see Section 5)


4. Prohibited Promotional Methods

The following promotional methods are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate account termination and forfeiture of commissions:

  • Coupon sites, deal aggregators, or cashback platforms
  • Comparison shopping sites
  • Brand bidding, using the BURKER brand name, variations, or misspellings as keywords in paid search ads
  • Push notification campaigns
  • Browser extensions or software-based promotion
  • Spam, unsolicited messaging, or misleading promotional claims
  • Adult, gambling, or otherwise inappropriate content environments
  • Any form of fraudulent activity, including self-referrals or artificial click generation

5. Affiliate Link and Discount Code

  • Each affiliate receives a unique personal affiliate link and discount code upon approval.
  • Commissions are tracked via the affiliate link and/or discount code usage.
  • Affiliates must not share or transfer their link or code to third parties for bulk or fraudulent use.
  • Affiliates can disclose their partnership with BURKER in all promotional content, in line with applicable advertising regulations (e.g. #ad, #sponsored).


6. Commission and Payouts

  • Base commission: 10% on every qualifying sale generated through the affiliate's personal link or discount code.
  • Minimum payout threshold: €100.
  • Payouts are processed via Wise (bank transfer in EUR or USD) upon request to ana@burker.com.
  • Commissions generated through prohibited channels (see Section 4) are not eligible for payout.
  • BURKER reserves the right to withhold or reverse commissions in cases of fraud, returns, or chargebacks.


7. Content rxpectations

  • Affiliates are expected to post a minimum of 2–3 times per month featuring BURKER products.
  • Content must be authentic, brand-aligned, and of good quality.
  • Affiliates must always include their personal link and/or discount code in promotional posts.
  • BURKER may provide campaign briefs, assets, and guidelines that affiliates are expected to follow.
  • BURKER reserves the right to request removal of content that misrepresents the brand.


8. Termination

  • BURKER may terminate an affiliate account at any time for violation of these terms, fraudulent activity, or inactivity exceeding 60 days.
  • Upon termination, any commissions generated through prohibited methods will be forfeited.
  • Eligible commissions accrued prior to termination will be paid out if the minimum threshold has been reached.
  • Affiliates may also choose to leave the programme at any time by notifying BURKER in writing.

9. Liability

BURKER is not liable for any loss of earnings resulting from changes to the programme, technical issues, or account termination due to policy violations. Affiliates are responsible for ensuring their promotional activities comply with applicable laws and platform guidelines in their country of residence.


10. Contact

For any questions regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact:

Ana Visser ana@burker.com | burkerwatches.co
